text:
Sam: Quick note  we've had a few postmortems with lingering remediations. proposing a time-boxed remediation flow to improve ownership and visibility. idea: 36h owner ack, 5d remediation sprint, 7-week recurrence review.
Lee: Curious why 36h ack vs 48/72h?
Sam: want owners to engage sooner so blockers show up quickly. we can make it severity-driven: sev1/2 => 36h, sev3+ => 72h.
Priya: Template suggestion (short, copy/pasteable) so people don't invent fields every time:
```
Time-boxed remediation template
- Owner (required): <name>    Backup: <name>
- Severity: <1|2|3|4>
- Impact estimate: low/med/high + dev hours
- Owner ack: T+36h (or T+72h for low severity) 
- T+72h: status (on-track|blocked|needs help) + PR/ticket link
- T+5d: remediation sprint close (close or extend with reason)
- T+21d: interim regression check
- T+49d: recurrence review & escalate if repeated
Automation: oncall-bot creates a minimal tracker at T+0 and pings at T+36h and T+5d
Suggested T+36h ack message: "Ack. Impact: med. ETA: 3d. Blockers: none."
```
Morgan: Add a required "remediation dashboard tag" (e.g., pm-timebox) so the remediation dashboard can filter pilot tickets. also add an explicit "expected dev hours" field.
oncall-bot: Action tracker created in #private-action-tracker for thread 1961234567. Reminders scheduled for T+36h and T+5d.
Lee: Rotation/Bump: keep IC rotation weekly, but require IC to be listed on the PM doc and in the tracker. if the remediation crosses >7d, IC posts a handoff note with a 1-paragraph context summary.
Priya: Comms cadence: engineer channel notices at T+36h and T+5d. execs receive a weekly 1-line summary for sev1/2 until closure: "Incident: owner, ETA, status".
Sam: Automation asks: oncall-bot to create ticket skeleton in Jira with fields: owner, backup, impact, ETA, expected hours, tag pm-timebox. schedule a lightweight regression-replay job at T+21d and T+49d (if job finds signal, flag for recurrence review).
Morgan: Pilot ask: run for next 9 incidents (mix of sev1-3). measure: % owner ack within window, % remediations closed by T+5d, median time-to-close, recurrence in 7 weeks.
EngOps: Good plan. run the pilot and collect metrics. if we see >30% improvement in time-to-close, we'll fold fields into the canonical incident template.
Sam: I'll update the incident playbook with the template and add example wording. volunteers to audit pilot data?
Priya: I'll help pull metrics and validate the regression-replay results.
Sam: thanks. starting pilot immediately for next incident. we'll reconvene after pilot ends and decide on rollout. :rocket:
